differences.openwhisper: MeetingEngine.set_cloud_enabled(True/False) toggles AI insights while the meeting is active or paused: on restarts the agent with the send cursor seeded (forward-only), off stops the scheduler and core and sets finalization disabled.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: set_cloud_enabled(true) is refused ('Start the meeting with AI insights to authorize its destination.'); turning insights on mid-meeting is enable_live_intelligence(route, backup) after the provider authorizes that exact destination, with the delivery cursors advanced to the high water so nothing spoken while off is sent. Turning off is set_cloud_enabled(false).
differences.reason: Sending a meeting's transcript to a hosted model or an installed agent needs approval of that meeting's destination each time; no stored or browser-side toggle can grant it.
differences.source: Differences a04-meeting-insights-per-meeting (docs/port/audit/a04-runtime-services.json) and a30-dashboard-fresh-approval (docs/port/audit/a30-meeting-web-server-and-dashboard-contract.json); src/meeting/detail/live_intelligence.cpp set_cloud_enabled, enable_live_intelligence; tests/meeting/test_engine_end.cpp ('live intelligence can resume only with the approved exact destination', 'live note requests share the approved scheduler and refuse after opt-out'), tests/meeting/test_engine_intelligence.cpp ('test_backup_only_gets_transcript_since_insights_were_turned_back_on').

differences.openwhisper: The meeting agent is a TypeScript sidecar (Pi or OpenCode); End reuses the live scheduler and core for the cleanup and report passes, then _wrap_up_end stops the scheduler and shuts the core down.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: The agent is the native in-process loop. The live core and scheduler are shut down when End drains capture; when the live agent was online and healthy, each final pass runs through a throwaway core of the provider, otherwise the card reads 'Meeting intelligence is offline; final cloud insights could not run. <why>' as OpenWhisper does. Wrap-up keeps final highlights (complete meetings only) and the optional insight review.
differences.reason: The sidecars are replaced by a native agent loop, and a live core is not kept open past the meeting.
